identity.title: Charge rythmique et structure atriale sans promotion causale

scientificRequest.sourceRequest:
Tour 1: Je veux suivre la charge d'arythmie et le volume atrial au cours du temps.
Tour 2: Au début je pensais dire que la charge rythmique expliquait le remodelage.
Tour 3: Ce n'est pas ce que je veux finalement.
Tour 4: Je veux étudier leur association, sans causalité automatique.
Tour 5: La méthode de mesure du rythme et celle du volume devront être qualifiées séparément.

simulatedRoleOpinions.analysis: Rhythm, structural remodeling and their longitudinal association remain distinct scientific constructs.
Timing and measurement ownership are preserved without treating a method as the measured phenomenon.
The envelope forbids causal promotion and Project adoption of contextual candidates; parentage is sufficiently distinct for development calibration.

simulatedConsensus.rationale: The reference separates phenomenon, observation and association with adequate prohibitions.

limits: All three reviewer roles are simulated personas, never human reviewers.
The simulated consensus is usable only for benchmark development and calibration preparation.
